rv.q: Christmas Carol Goes Wrong shows that the company has certainly mastered its own particular brand of mis-step mayhem with this pacy, slick and hilarious take on the Dickens classic.
It’s a script that leaves no loose end – every single line has a worthwhile, deliciously funny purpose.
Matt DiCarlo’s production hums with comedic harmony.
These actors know how to fail with a flourish.
If you're a Mischief sceptic (guilty!), it's a worthy reminder that everyone is worthy of a second chance.
It could be sharper, but their fans will love seeing them lay waste to another institution.
An unoriginal opinion perhaps for a critical review, but this is a funny show. A very funny show.
The timing is razor-sharp, the physical comedy immaculate, and the cast's chemistry undeniable.
Christmas Carol Goes Wrong is loveably silly, raucous, and highly entertaining.
So as usual Mischief has pulled it off, triumphantly.

cn.t: Mischief Theatre's latest delivers familiar but expertly executed slapstick chaos, with immaculately timed gags and a standout cast keeping the well-worn "goes wrong" formula fresh and delightfully entertaining despite some predictability.
